notes.title: Weekly Patch and Story Lines
notes.notes:
[h1]
Weekly Patch Improvements May 2024

[/h1]
[h2]Random Battle[/h2]
* Update random battles to have pre and post-events.
* Some random encounters will have quests or storylines attached to them.
* Updated some of the female images.

[h2]Towns.[/h2]
* Started new storylines and rewards for stripping every woman in the town.
* Only one woman per town will have an option. (Town 1 finished)

[h2]StaMana Rules changed[/h2]
* Some romantic encounters will now require StaMana and drain stamina after.

[h2] More Scenes [/h2]
* added two more scenes

notes.title: Highland Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Highland Patch[/h1]

* 4 out of the 5 town characters can now lose their top during combat.
  * Power punches and criticals now cause clothes to come off.
* Enemy and Player Characters have a small chance of missing in combat.
* Player Character critical chances increased.
  * Instant Mana if player criticals. 
  * Critical chance increases as player levels.
* Removed debug text about quest requirements and added a screen that is easier to read.
